name: drafts bend, confirmed documents do not
notes: INV-3 (no mutation past draft), INV-5 (committed exposure), INV-20 (derived states). Amendment, cancellation, and the exact moment an order stops being editable.

steps.notes: a draft is a conversation — replace the lines freely, the log keeps every version
close_short is for confirmed orders with an unfulfilled tail — a draft has nothing committed to abandon
INV-5: the moment of confirmation, the order's value counts against credit — before any invoice exists

expect.refused: Only a draft order can be amended

steps.notes: INV-3: what was confirmed is the fact the credit gate evaluated. Growth is a new order; shrink is close_short

args.reason: customer withdrew the PO before we picked anything

steps.notes: cancellation is only possible while nothing has been fulfilled — after that, the honest path is bill and credit-note
cancelling releases the committed exposure; the credit line breathes again

expect.refused: Only a draft order can be confirmed

steps.notes: INV-9 in spirit: the cancelled order stays on the books, visible, number and lines intact — nothing is ever deleted
